question.question: Do six dynamic relation-query layers recover accuracy beyond six propagation layers and the original head?
question.deficiency: The final GPTrans head reads only the molecular node and self pair; the value of continuing all-atom propagation versus differentiable query readout is unmeasured.
alternatives: Dynamic relation queries recover useful computation
question.positive_decision: Establish C-B readout value only for >=3meV improvement with upper paired95%CI<0; no cross-slot strict causal or promotion claim.
question.negative_decision: Retain truthful quality/cost evidence; no automatic successor, baseline substitution or scale-up.

profile.hardware: Tesla T4x2 FP32, one independent arm per device
profile.cheapest_falsifier: Same-job paired100K complete60 epochs; independent truncation pair separates removed propagation from readout value.
